name: How do I know when it is time to repaint my ceiling?

mainEntity.name: How do I know when it is time to repaint my ceiling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repainting becomes necessary when you notice yellowing, water stains, peeling paint, or visible stress cracks along drywall joints. Over time, sunlight, cooking oils, and heating systems dull white ceiling paint, making rooms feel shorter and darker. Homes experiencing minor foundation movement or seasonal settling around Denver and Aurora often develop hairline cracks at drywall seams that require taping and painting. If ceiling paint is flaking or separating, it indicates poor original adhesion, excessive bathroom humidity, or trapped moisture that must be addressed before applying a new finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for yellowing, surface stains, peeling paint, or hairline drywall cracks from home settling, which signal it is time to repair and repaint.
